findings.title: Documented steps lack run evidence (AC6)
findings.problem: The spec requires every step in the integration doc to have been executed during verification. verification-report.md line 24 states the UI registration click path was not re-run (doc section 2 steps 1-3), and there is no run evidence for the 24-hour token lifetime (line 39) or the bearer/basic/API key/AWS credential styles (line 49). The A2A_* timeout defaults are evidenced; the other defaults are not shown.
findings.impact: Story AC6 is only partially met; readers may follow unverified setup instructions or rely on unconfirmed claims about token lifetime and credential styles.
findings.recommendation: Run and record the UI registration path, the token lifetime and each credential style in verification-report.md, or remove or explicitly mark as unverified the claims that cannot be demonstrated.

findings.title: Wrapper guide copies unverified demo-agent code
findings.problem: Sections 3.1, 3.2 and 4 (around lines 249-281, 313-321, 327) reproduce demo-agent executor and AgentCard code, SDK helper names and error text. The spec says code should appear only where it pins the mapping and agent details should be referenced from the agents repo; the verification report covers only wire output, not these snippets.
findings.impact: Snippets can drift or be wrong while EPMCDME-15348 (agent-side A2A) is unfinished, misleading developers adding a wrapper.
findings.recommendation: Trim snippets to the minimal mapping illustration and link to the agents repo for the full code, or verify each snippet against the agents repo and note the version it matches.
